subject: python
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for fairlearn; owner to confirm (ADR-0346)
why: the CPython runtime of the base image (the same pinned python:3.12-slim-trixie as garak's and spikee's); PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the ADR-0176 list. Accepted for garak on 2026-10-10 (ADR-0187 decision 193).

subject: numpy
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for fairlearn; owner to confirm (ADR-0346)
why: fairlearn's, pandas' and scikit-learn's array library; numpy 2.5.5's License-Expression is BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0, and Zlib is the one term outside the ADR-0176 list: a permissive licence on code numpy ships. Accepted for modelscan and reused for garak and spikee (ADR-0187 decision 106).

subject: scipy.libs/libgfortran
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for fairlearn; owner to confirm (ADR-0346)
why: the GCC Fortran runtime under the GCC Runtime Library Exception, shipped unmodified inside scipy's wheel (two builds, both named by scipy's dist-info LICENSE.txt). Decision 106 accepted this library under this licence inside numpy's wheel; here it is the same library inside scipy's, which scikit-learn needs.

subject: scipy.libs/libquadmath
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for fairlearn; owner to confirm (ADR-0346)
why: an unmodified, dynamically linked LGPL library shipped as its own shared object inside scipy's wheel (two builds, named by scipy's dist-info LICENSE.txt). Decision 106 accepted it inside numpy's wheel; here it is the same library inside scipy's.

subject: scikit_learn.libs/libgomp
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for fairlearn; owner to confirm (ADR-0346)
why: the GNU OpenMP runtime, shipped unmodified inside scikit-learn's wheel (its licenses/COPYING names it as the GCC runtime library under the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1). Decision 106 accepted a GCC runtime library (libgfortran) under exactly this licence; libgomp is another library of the same runtime under the same exception, so the reuse is by licence, not by the same file: the owner should confirm it.
